A large white-skinned man with bright orange hair and orange eyebrows dominates the left and upper portions of this vertical editorial illustration. His face is shown in profile, oriented to the right, with a prominent nose and a slight smile. He wears a dark suit jacket and a white dress shirt with a visible cuff. His oversized white right hand and arm extend towards the bottom right. The index finger and thumb are pinched together, grasping the tiny right hand of a much smaller man. 

The smaller man stands in the bottom right corner, looking up at the large man. He has dark hair and wears an orange long-sleeved shirt. The background is a solid blue with a fine, dark speckled texture. 

Bold white text to the right of the larger man reads: "Atas Nama Bangsa Amerika". Below this is a smaller paragraph of white text. Red text across the top reads: "Nadiem Makarim Makin Terpojok H.30" and "Logika Terbalik RUU KUHAP H.90". The word "TEMPO" appears in large red letters behind the larger man's head. A white barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner. Vertical text at the bottom center reads: "28 JULI-3 AGUSTUS 2025", "RP 60.000", "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN 0126 - 4273".
